function.name: send_sticker
function.description: Send a WhatsApp sticker from the local stickers library, or list what is available. Use this when a sticker matches the vibe better than (or as well as) plain text: greetings with respect, Nigerian hail/oga energy, humour, or a reaction that has a matching pack. Call list if you are unsure which id to pick. After sending, still write a short normal text reply. Never mention that you sent a sticker.

action.description: list: return every sticker id, folder, path, description, and whenToUse. send: deliver one sticker to the current chat. Default send.

id.description: Sticker id from stickers/config.json, for example my_boss. Also accepts the folder name.
